changes.title: Runaways beach
items: Beaten creatures no longer vanish: they run to the nearest beach and sleep there. Win the night and they sleep on; lose it and they go home to bed with everyone else

changes.title: Fewer repeats
items: Islands repeat their kinds less: besides the island's own creature (about one area in six), no kind lives in more than two areas, so every island has more kinds to meet

changes.title: Legend attacks
items: Awake legends throw their kind's attack across the forest: a huge slow bomb you can see coming for seconds, bursting into a bigger, wilder version of their kind's attack. Happy legends' bombs chase down the enraged for you
